summary.intent: Understand whether the Entire hook that is failing and printing panics lives on the git side or the Claude Code side, and how each affects pushes and turn-end output.
summary.outcome: Established that there are two separate Entire hooks, a git pre-push hook that blocks pushes and a Claude Code stop hook that only prints the panic at turn end, both crashing in the same Entire code path (readFoldsCase) because of a git config failure. The registration location of the Claude-side hook was not verified.

repo: This repo's core.hooksPath points at /Users/gabe/Projects/oxc-react-codegen/.moon/hooks, so its git hooks live in another project's directory.
Entire installs commit-msg, post-commit, post-rewrite, pre-push and prepare-commit-msg scripts in that hooks directory.
The pre-push hook runs `entire hooks git pre-push origin` before pushing and exits non-zero if Entire crashes, which blocks the push.
workflow: `git push --no-verify` skips the git-side Entire hooks and is the workaround for blocked pushes.
The Claude-side hook is `entire hooks claude-code stop`, run via `sh -c` at the end of each turn; it does not block pushes and is unaffected by --no-verify.
To silence the Claude-side panic output without fixing Entire, disable the stop hook in Claude Code settings.
Both hooks fail in the same Entire code (readFoldsCase) on git config, so fixing or rolling back the Entire binary resolves both.

friction: Entire's git pre-push hook crashes and blocks every push until --no-verify is used or Entire is fixed.
Entire's stop hook prints a panic at the end of every Claude turn and fails to record the session log.
Git hooks for this repo are located in an unrelated project's directory via core.hooksPath, making them harder to find.
open_items: Fix or roll back the Entire binary so readFoldsCase no longer fails on the git config.
Locate where the Claude-side stop hook is registered (user vs project settings), which was not verified.
Decide whether to disable the Claude stop hook in the meantime to stop the panic output.
